items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: He asked me to play lead trumpet once. Count Basie.

ctx.x: I used to have one like that.
That’s concerts that we do here at Hamilton. And I got Joe Williams on this side and Count Basie on the other side.
He asked me to play lead trumpet once. Count Basie.
